column2: [intro]
I have dolls, stuffed toys, and hats,
Old vinyl records, posters, and coats.
In my drawers, seashells and rare stamps,
And vintage toys that make me laugh.
I’m a collector, oh yes, it's true,
I gather things, it makes me happy.
At home, it’s a real museum, just for me,
Come see my collection, it's wonderful!
In my attic, boxes filled with trinkets,
Bits of string, old keys, even an old pot.
And in my room, a Johnny Hallyday poster,
I’m amazing, my objects tell me so.
I’m a collector, it's my passion,
I keep it all, even Grandma Jeanne’s peanuts.
I have shelves full of memories,
My life is a treasure, I love to cherish.
[solo]
I’m a collector, oh yes, it's true,
I gather things, it makes me happy.
At home, it’s a real museum, just for me,
Come see my collection, it's wonderful!
[outro]
